About This Condo

This property is a 35 SqM condo with 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom that is available for sale. It is part of the Nue Noble Srinakarin - Lasalle project in Samrong Nuea, Samut Prakan and was completed in Dec 2022. You can buy this condo for a base price of ฿3,000,000 (฿85,714/SqM).

2 bedroom corner room facing north, next to MRT Si La Salle. Building B14 — see the building floor plan for exact location. Fully furnished with extras.

  • Kitchen: Refrigerator, microwave, washer/dryer combo, electric stove top with air hood & light, large stone custom tile backsplash.
  • Bathroom: Glass shower, hot water, ample space for towels, personal items and storage.
  • Master bedroom: Queen bedframe & mattress, large closet & storage space, vanity, TCL 55" 4K TV, blackout curtains.
  • 2nd bedroom: Large single bedframe & mattress, full closet & storage space.
  • Living room: Sofa, entertainment table, Sony Bravia 55" OLED 4K TV, L-shaped desk from SB Design & office chair, 27" LG 4K HDR computer monitor.
  • Programmable keyless entry
  • 3 air conditioning units — 1 in each bedroom and 1 for the main living area
  • Balcony with an amazing view
  • Fabric roll-down blinds in all rooms
  • North-facing unit / no direct sunlight = low electricity bill
  • Gigabit fiber internet available

Ideal for a family, someone who needs dedicated office space, or investors — this area will continue to build and develop around the MRT Yellow Line, Bangna business district, and next to the top-ranked Sikarin Hospital. Next to MRT Si La Salle (YL18).

  • Covered Parking
  • Direct access to BTS/MRT
